evidence: Each judgment sees the original stored title and abstract as numbered exact spans, the frozen facet definition and the classifier evidence span. Positive reviewer judgments must identify a valid original span. The output is private except for IDs, titles, verdicts, exact permitted short source quotes and aggregate counts.
name: verified-facet-positive-resample-v1
sampling: Uniform random sample without replacement from positive tags in each facet, ordered by paper ID before selection; use SHA-256 of facet ID and the fixed seed to seed an independent Python random generator.
uncertain_denominator_policy: Count uncertain as unconfirmed in the conservative confirmed fraction and report separately. The resampling reviewer is the same model family as the original classifier, although different from the second-stage verifier; this is correlated model agreement, not human-verified precision.
